programme.title: 11th Annual Outhouse Races

programme.title: Swiss Stone Tossing

programme.title: 2025 National Bubble Gum Blowing Championship

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: A secret weapon's theft sends Agent 007 to Russia, where a pretty computer programmer helps him track an ex-cohort believed dead.

programme.title: Tomorrow Never Dies

programme.title: Casino Royale
programme.desc: After receiving a license to kill, British agent James Bond (Daniel Craig) enters a high-stakes poker game with Le Chiffre (Mads Mikkelsen), a man who finances terrorist groups.

programme.title: The Russia House
programme.desc: A London publisher turned spy (Sean Connery) falls in love with his Moscow contact (Michelle Pfeiffer).

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: In World War II, a Marine (Nicolas Cage) protects a Navajo recruit (Adam Beach) who transmits messages in his native tongue, confounding Japanese code-breakers.

programme.title: Noah

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: A former slave (Jamie Foxx) joins forces with the German bounty hunter (Christoph Waltz) who freed him and helps hunt down the South's most-wanted criminals, all in the hope of finding his long-lost wife (Kerry Washington).

programme.title: American Sniper
programme.desc: Sniper and U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle (Bradley Cooper) saves many lives on battlefields in Iraq while striving to be a good husband and father to his loved ones back in America.

programme.title: American Renegades
programme.desc: On assignment in war-torn Europe, Navy SEALs discover gold at the bottom of a lake -- a fortune rumored to be worth hundreds of millions of dollars. When the enemy detects the team, the SEALs are left with only 10 hours to recover the treasure.

programme.title: American Dream/American Knightmare
programme.desc: The life and exploits of Suge Knight, the co-founder of Death Row Records, and his influence on a highly influential era in music.

programme.title: The Riot Club
programme.desc: Two first-year students (Sam Claflin, Max Irons) at Oxford University join a secret society and learn that their reputations can be made or destroyed over the course of one evening.

programme.title: Black Noise
programme.desc: When an elite security team is sent to a remote island to rescue a VIP, their mission takes a turn as they are confronted by masked gunmen. To keep hold of their lives, the team must act quickly to assess the situation and escape the island.

programme.title: The Last Manhunt
programme.desc: In 1909 Willie Boy and his love, Carlota, go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers to hunt them down.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A quiet man and his son take in a wounded stranger near his homestead, along with a bag full of cash. The stranger claims he's a sheriff being pursued by outlaws, but the man can't be sure.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: A talented high school basketball player's (Taylor John Smith) dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his hard-drinking father's (Michael Shannon) compulsive gambling.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: An ex-cop doing prison time chases a virtual-reality killer from the program onto the Los Angeles streets.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Henry Hill, a poor Irish-Italian growing up in 1950s New York City, rises through the ranks of his neighborhood's organized crime branch; he ends up in the FBI's witness protection program after testifying against his former partners.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: Enraged by the killing of his wife, Scotsman William Wallace leads a revolt against the tyrannical English king in the 13th century.

programme.title: Panama
programme.desc: A defense contractor hires an ex-marine to go to Panama to complete an arms deal. In the process, he becomes involved in the U.S. invasion of Panama.

programme.title: The Ledge
programme.desc: After an atheistic neighbor (Charlie Hunnam) has an affair with his wife, a vengeful Fundamentalist forces the man to choose between killing himself or allowing someone else to die in his place.

programme.title: Savage
programme.desc: Torn between his biological family and the gang he now calls his own, a man has to make a choice.

programme.title: La Madrina: The Savage Life of Lorine Padilla
programme.desc: Lorine Padilla joins a street gang in the Bronx, N.Y., before becoming an activist and spiritual adviser.

programme.title: Mona Lisa and the Blood Moon
programme.desc: When a struggling single mother befriends a mysterious woman who has supernatural powers, she sees a lucrative opportunity to make some fast cash. However, their crime spree soon draws unwanted attention as the cops start to close in.

programme.desc: A young man and his traveling companions battle an array of monsters during an 80-mile journey to find the woman he loves.

programme.desc: An astronaut struggles to maintain his grip on reality during a possibly compromised mission to Saturn's moon, Titan.

programme.title: Un si grand soleil
programme.desc: Claire revient à Montpellier après dix-sept ans d'absence, afin de faire découvrir à Théo, son fils adolescent, sa ville natale. Quelques heures plus tard, elle est en garde à vue, accusée du meurtre d'un ami d'enfance.

programme.title: Merci professeur!
programme.desc: Une chronique sur la langue française, ses curiosités, son actualité et ses accents.

programme.title: Tout le monde ment
programme.desc: Vincent, un policier qui en a trop vu, persuadé que tout le monde ment, ne sait plus dire que la vérité. Une nouvelle équipe de policiers dévolue aux enquêtes touchant exclusivement les milieux de l'argent et du pouvoir.

programme.title: Chef pays
programme.desc: La cheffe Louise Denisot prépare un fish and chips au vivaneau.

programme.title: Lou et Sophie
programme.desc: Depuis trois semaines, Lou et Sophie sont dans un chalet à la Baie-des-Chaleurs; un rêve qui vire au cauchemar quand elles sont obligées de rembarquer dans Dolorès et revenir sur la Rive-Nord.

programme.title: Lou et Sophie
programme.desc: Pendant que Sophie et Jules renouent au dépanneur, Lou fait la rencontre d'un nouveau collègue qu'elle ne tardera pas à détester; finalement obligée d'aller en date avec Jimmy, Sophie n'a pas la tête à lancer des haches.

programme.title: Le 6h info
programme.desc: Ce rendez-vous réveil-matin propose de faire un point sur l'actualité, assorti de différentes rubriques permettant d'explorer certains aspects plus en profondeur.

programme.title: Fourbi
programme.desc: Un cinéaste tourne un film sur l'histoire vécue d'une jeune femme accusée d'avoir tué l'homme qui voulait la violer.

programme.title: La revue culturelle 2024
programme.desc: On célèbre les grands moments culturels d'ici: des arts de la scène à la littérature en passant par la musique, les arts visuels et le cinéma; au menu: discussions, prestations et histoires marquantes!

programme.title: Jean-Michel Basquiat, Paris For Ever
